{{Top|leg|title=j'ber V'Sook}}
'''J'ber V'Sook''' was a small [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[j'ber]] that, in the wake of [[Se'Lenti|the Scouring]], created a religious philosophy known as [[M'Nes]], or the "True Faith." The religion was first preached by [[V'Sook M'Alra Vin]], and spread across [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] over the centuries. J'ber V'Sook was considered to be the '''M'Nes Brin''' ("Receptacle of the True Faith"), and all of the female members of the j'ber were known as [[K'Kela Mey]] ("Mothers of the True Faith").
